title: Pulse
tagline: Product analytics: dashboards, an events explorer, funnels and users
description: A product analytics app for a docs product, with live stats, charts, an events explorer, conversion funnels and a users table. Built from the Junco app shell, blocks and data table, with a ⌘K command palette and light and dark themes.
features: AppShell with collapsible sidebar and phone sheet nav
⌘K command palette for pages, actions and people
Sortable, filterable events table with a details sheet
Conversion funnels with drop-off per step
Users table with row menus, selection and profiles
Settings with switches, selects and a danger zone
